summary: Direct authoring task (not a merge-gate review of a coder branch): started a fresh C#-developer doc tree that mirrors the code, living inside PLang/app/ as start.md files. v1 delivers the fundamentals — the app root (PLang/app/start.md), the module system (module/start.md), and the file module as a worked example (module/file/start.md). Every page maps plang -> C# -> source and every claim is verified against current source, replacing the stale Documentation/architecture.md.

changes.description: App root + 'how to read this codebase' primer: path=namespace=plang-name, the /this.cs + @this pattern, GlobalUsings aliases, node/verb casing, the collection-node pattern (app.X / .list / .current), how item.list works, Data as carrier, and a plang->C#->source cheat-sheet.

The module system: registry (selection+lifecycle), discovery via Discover + [Action] (module name = namespace after app.module), the action handler pattern, attribute reference, dispatch from a built .pr step to Start() (real decide.pr), and 'the type is the role'. Points to os/system/modules/<module>/ for teaching prose, does not duplicate.

The file module end to end: seven actions mapped (plang->file->[Action]->return->cacheable), read as the canonical handler walkthrough, exists as path-truthiness (IBooleanResolvable), and the mutating actions' shared From+Use shape.
